question: For every family SOURCE_BLOCKED in MASTER_QUEUE.json and classed ATTACH_HELD_SOURCE in SOURCE_BACKLOG_CLASSIFICATION.json, which official-form labels are still unbound, and what does the document each unbound label names actually print on its own face?

summary.familiesExaminedNote: Every family whose MASTER_QUEUE state is SOURCE_BLOCKED and whose SOURCE_BACKLOG_CLASSIFICATION class is ATTACH_HELD_SOURCE. Seven of them (ga-nonconv-pre2013-set and the six ks-* families) carry an empty sourceIds array and name their forms in forms[] instead; their unbound labels were taken from forms[]. Two families named by Captain, ar-act346-set and ar-veterans-court-set, are classed ACQUIRE_EXACT_SOURCE rather than ATTACH_HELD_SOURCE; they were examined anyway because Captain named them, and are reported under refusals and absences.

familiesAdvancedButNotCompleted.ar-misdemeanor-seal-set: order confirmed from its face, Act 1460 misdemeanor petition absent (1 of 2)

summary.arithmetic: 17 resolved + 2 unresolved + 40 absent = 59 unbound label-family pairs. The 17 resolutions are carried by 8 distinct artifacts because the three Kansas documents each serve four families and the two Arkansas felony documents serve one.

theFindingThatMattersMost: The nineteen-family petition-and-order shape Captain described is real, but in the mounted corpus it is not a reading failure - it is an absence. Of the label-family pairs in scope, only eight could be resolved by opening a document. Twenty-seven name documents that are not in the mounted corpus at all, and sixteen more name documents whose only plausible neighbours print, on their own faces, that they are something else. The reason is structural and was not visible from the classification file: private/Nationwide Record Clearing is NOT mounted in this session. Every ATTACH_HELD_SOURCE finding whose held.pathInArchive begins "LegalEase <State>/" points into that unmounted tree. Those artifacts cannot be read, cannot be hashed, and cannot be admitted by a reconciler that requires the committed corpus index to hold the path and hash - because the index does not index that tree either. GA and HI have no shard in any mounted custody at all.

mounted.note: a single TX statement of inability to afford costs; irrelevant to every label in scope

mountedCorpusReality.notMounted: private/Nationwide Record Clearing - the operational tree. private/source-corpus-environment.txt leaves OFFICIAL_FORMS_SOURCE_DIR commented out and warns that it is a different corpus which this release does not carry.
mountedCorpusReality.consequenceForCaptain: Classification rows whose held.pathInArchive starts with "LegalEase " are unverifiable and unbindable from this session. They are not wrong; they are unreachable. Treat them as a separate class from ATTACH_HELD_SOURCE until either the Nationwide tree is mounted and indexed or the documents are ingested into the Master Library.

method.read: pdftotext -f 1 -l 2 -layout <file> - for the printed face, plus a full-text pdftotext -layout pass wherever page one printed no form number or revision, and page-by-page reads where a petition and an order might share one file.
method.identityRule: Identity was taken only from what the document prints on its own face: issuing authority, official title, form number, revision, and the statute or rule it recites. No identity was taken from a filename or from the corpus index's recorded title. Two index titles were found to be wrong and are reported below.
method.hashRule: Every sha256 in this file was recomputed with sha256sum on the file this lane opened. No hash was copied from the corpus index or from another finding. Every recomputed hash was then compared against the committed index row for that path; all 24 matched, and inCommittedCorpusIndexAtThisPathAndHash records that.
method.pairRule: Petition and order were checked as separate instruments by reading the operative line: a petition prints "Comes the Defendant", an order prints "Before the Court is the Petition ... the Court finds and orders". No order was allowed to stand in for a petition or the reverse.
method.confidenceRule: No existing confidence was edited. Where a document already carried confirmed_from_corpus_title or confirmed_from_recorded_title and this lane opened it, a new finding at confirmed_from_document_text was written with its own evidence. Where this lane did not open a document, nothing was written for it.
